title: Entropy prioritizer for security & compliance requests (SLA-aware triage)
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Problem: Enterprise sales and customer success are blocked by a growing backlog of bespoke security and compliance asks (SOC2 attachments, DPA negotiations, GDPR residency questions, HIPAA scoping, and long vendor questionnaires). Current manual routing creates unpredictable SLAs and uneven allocation of legal/security/engineering effort.

Goal: Ship an automated, auditable triage service that scores incoming requests using a small, explainable feature set (customer ARR, contract stage, hosting mode, data sensitivity, requested artifact type, jurisdiction risk, historical repeat rate) and maps score bands to an SLA lane and an owner queue (Legal, Security, Solutions Eng, Self-serve). The system must be configurable (thresholds, weights) and surfaced in Console + Intake dashboard for override and audit.

Out-of-scope for MVP: full LLM answer generation for questionnaires, contract negotiation templates. MVP focuses on routing, SLA estimates, and evidence bundling pointers.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic scoring function is implemented in the intake service and documented with feature definitions and weights
Incoming requests are auto-assigned to SLA lanes (Immediate: 48h, Standard: 5 business days, Low: 20 business days) based on score and visible in the Intake dashboard
Console UI shows per-request rationale (top 3 signals) and provides a single-click "Escalate" override to reassign queue with audit trail
Metrics: median time-to-first-response improved by 35% for enterprise compliance asks in the pilot cohort; SLA miss rate <10% for Immediate lane during pilot
Integration points: Legal ticketing (Zendesk/GH issues), Security tracker, and a generated evidence-bundle pointer (link to template in Drive) for common ask types
